# Cirth v0.7.0

Cirth v0.7.0 modernizes the reset layer against modern-normalize v3 and
Tailwind Preflight v4, purges over a dozen dead IE/legacy-browser rules,
and adds two new structural utility classes. No breaking changes to the
published CSS.

## Highlights

- **Reset layer modernized.** Cirth's reboot descended from normalize v8
  (2018) + sanitize v13 (2021) — years past the Browserslist floor those
  resets actually target. Every IE/dead-browser rule modern-normalize v3
  also dropped is gone from `src/` (`-ms-touch-action`, `::-ms-expand`,
  legacy `overflow`/`display` fixes, and more), for a smaller build
  despite two new utilities shipping in the same release.
- **Four real bugs fixed**: `[hidden]` no longer disables Chrome/Edge's
  `hidden="until-found"` find-in-page state; Firefox placeholders no
  longer render doubly faded; a dead `:-moz-focusring`/
  `::-moz-focus-inner` hack that was silently killing Firefox focus
  rings on unstyled controls is gone; `::-webkit-file-upload-button`
  is unified with the standard `::file-selector-button` used everywhere
  else. A fifth, unplanned one turned up along the way: `<small>`'s
  font-size token was set but never actually consumed, so it had been
  silently rendering at the browser default this whole time.
- **Two new utilities**: `.sr-only` / `.sr-only-focusable` (modern
  `clip-path`-based screen-reader-only pattern, with a focus-revealed
  variant for skip links) and `.truncate` (single-line ellipsis
  overflow). Both classes-build only.

## Fixed

See the [Changelog](https://github.com/cirthcss/cirth/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#070---2026-08-02)
for the complete, itemized list of fixes and removals.
